data.gender_notes: Tomi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Tomas, which means 'twin'. In the New Testament, the apostle Thomas is known as 'Doubting Thomas' for his lack of faith. Tomi may be a feminine variant, symbolizing a strong, unwavering friend. The name Tomi carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tomi usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering support and loyalty.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tomi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
